entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-31
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Specialfolder.MyDocuments returns localized name for folder instead of actual folder name on windows. #123844
  • SystemTrustCertificateWithCustomRootTrust failure in CI #123843
  • ILC throws an IndexOutOfRangeException #123833

Closed

  • [API Proposal]: IMemoryOwner<T> clearing memory upon returning the array #123837
  • JIT: fix arm32 dump/disasm of references to async resume info #123813
  • LINQ Append and Prepend in Count speed optimization can overflow #123820
  • GetThreadStaticsBase method is not included in R2R image #123616
    11.0.0
  • Flag bit checks could be merged together #123829

PullRequests

Created

  • NO-MERGE: use staging Helix #123846
    NO-MERGE, needs-area-label
  • Introduce factory methods to create assertions #123845
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Remove no-op string.Format calls with single message argument #123842
  • Fix AttemptAcquire(0) when token isn't available #123841
    area-System.Threading, community-contribution
  • SPMI: Update superpmi-diffs queue to OSX.15.Arm64.Open #123840
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Look through async thunks in `RuntimeHelpers.PrepareMethod` #123838
    needs-area-label
  • Avoid unnecessary array allocations in ZipArchive #123836
    area-System.IO.Compression
  • Remove extra array allocations from TarHeader.GetLongMetadataStream #123835
    area-System.Formats.Tar
  • Remove no-op SR.Format calls with single message argument #123834
    area-Meta
  • Replace some uses of `MethodDescCallSite` with `UnmanagedCallersOnly` methods #123832
    area-VM-coreclr, 11.0.0
  • [NativeAOT] fix NAOT mappings (follow-up to https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/123333) #123831
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • Change Interpreter to share code with the JIT and use its CompAllocator #123830
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • HTTP/2: Add automatic downgrade to HTTP/1.1 for Windows authentication #123827
    area-System.Net.Http
  • Add null check for ThreadLocalStoragePointer in COMUnhandledExceptionFilter to prevent crash on Windows #123826
    area-ExceptionHandling-coreclr

Merged

  • JIT: remove anticipated demand for throw helpers #123781
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • SPMI: Update superpmi-collect queues from osx13 to osx15 #123839
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • JIT: fix arm32 dump/disasm of references to async resume info #123814

    area-System.Linq
  • Fix GetThreadStaticsBase to be included in R2R images #123812
  • Migrate test exclusions from issues.targets to inline ActiveIssue attributes #123248
    area-Infrastructure
  • Fix length when getting property from host #123774
    area-Host

    area-Diagnostics-coreclr, runtime-async
  • Enable ARM (32-bit) deb/rpm package generation #122349
    area-Infrastructure-installer, community-contribution

    area-System.Net.Sockets, os-android, community-contribution
  • Fix #74020: Optimize consecutive shifts in JIT Lowering #122533
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Fix Mono Debugger 200ms Pause (Issue #122344) #122449
    area-Debugger-mono, community-contribution
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 679: Build ID 2892413 #123746
